turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: Earlier today, while I was watching TV, I suddenly and painlessly lost vision in my right eye. It started about 30 minutes ago.
Is the vision loss complete, like total darkness
Yes, it feels complete—mostly total darkness in my right eye. I didn’t have any pain or other symptoms with it.
How old are you, and do you have any medical conditions like high blood pressure, diabetes, or heart problems?
I’m 60 years old. I have high blood pressure, type 2 diabetes, and coronary artery disease. I’ve also had some trouble sticking to my medications regularly.
